facts.fact: Styx 站在海堤上啃苹果打断水下缠绵，喊 Maddox「silly rabbit」，还吃醋抱怨自己的美人鱼从没这样对他。
facts.anchor: What are ya doing, silly rabbit?

facts.fact: Saleeni 为护主瞬间暴走：浑身变暗发亮如鳗、胸前覆上黑色皮质鳞片，如鲨鱼般出水向 Styx 尖啸。
facts.anchor: Her whole body had gone menacingly dark and slick like an eel

facts.fact: Saleeni 亮出獠牙，Maddox 撂下「Do it if you dare」，她扯住他头发用利齿划开他的右胸。
facts.anchor: Then razor-sharp teeth slashed the right side of my chest

facts.fact: 轮到 Maddox 蜕变：上颚剧痛、门牙缓慢移位，鲜血滴入海面，他连她的名字都念不清。
facts.anchor: My front teeth felt like they were rearranging, slowly

facts.fact: Maddox 惊恐意识到：他与 Misfits 们血液相连，自己正在变成的东西可能已经传染给朋友们。
facts.anchor: I might have infected my friends with whatever I was becoming

facts.fact: 胸口伤口无药自愈，留下黑色古老符号——他被她做了标记，图案像远古洞穴壁画。
facts.anchor: The image looked ancient appearance, like something you would imagine on the wall of a cave

facts.fact: 次晨 Styx 确认他的手、胸、新牙全部愈合；Maddox 崩溃时两人掌心相贴齐诵「Nothing is impossible」把他拉回来。
facts.anchor: Nothing is impossible. Nothing is impossible…

facts.fact: Styx 交代：Noma 病重时主动向他求婚，好让他合法接管她的财产，死后留给真正的 Maddox Gentry 一笔 nest egg。
facts.anchor: she asked me to marry her so that, legally, I could be responsible for the real Maddox Gentry

facts.fact: Styx 承认带走 Maddox 的原因：他为 Baby Blue 复仇跟踪牧师，会害死寄养全家；Maddox 吼叫那个牧师该死，镜中亮出新獠牙。
facts.anchor: You were about to get them all killed, acting like a rogue maniac, stalking that pastor of a church
